newsitem.title: USA: Inland Steel steel unit profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Inland Steel steel unit profit rises.

text.p: Inland Steel Industries Inc said Monday its Inland Steel Co unit posted an operating profit of $49.0 million in the second quarter, up from $11.3 million a year ago.
The current quarter profit included a $9.0 million gain from the sale of its interest in the Wabush iron ore property.
Inland Steel sold 1,375,000 tons in the quarter, a four percent increase, making it the highest second-quarter shipping volume since 1984.
Net sales from steel manufacturing operations rose to $643.8 million in the second quarter compared with $604.9 million.

Inland said Ryerson Tull Inc, of which it owns 87 percent, generated an operating profit of $42.3 million in the second quarter, including a gain on the sale of its closed Boston plant of $6.9 million. This compared with a year-ago profit of $32.7 million.

Earlier, Inland Steel Industries reported second quarter earnings of $0.77 a share, up from $0.35 a year ago. Excluding items in both periods, the company's net income rose to $0.59 a share from $0.25.
